description: Morphs one atom into another on the film's progress dial p, joining their elements by data key: two views of the same data (a treemap and a sunburst, a table and an org chart) hand over element by element instead of cross-fading. Each element of the second block that shares a key with the first starts on its partner's box and travels to its own place; with path keys a total starts on the union of its parts (Cloud collects Cloud/VMs and Cloud/Storage) and a part starts on its total; elements only in one block fade. Labels only fade. With reduced motion, on static surfaces or when no timeline sets p, the page shows the second block exactly as it renders alone.
